cause.summary: Which fits count as converged is NLMIXED's verdict, and NLMIXED cannot be run here. Our NLMIXED-like optimizer gives 55, 77, 82% at 30 groups x 5 (paper 56, 68, 76); the bias and coverage of the group-size-5 cells move with which fits are kept. No variant of the optimizer settings moves 30 groups x 5 to the paper's rates (replicates 0-199: without σ01 96, 98, 98%, without ABSXCONV 38, 62, 78%, 2,000 function calls 68, 76, 86%, fewer quadrature points 60, 80, 86%, 3 points 62, 74, 88%). On 200 data sets per design, whose tolerance is wider, three variants score all 27 convergence cells, as our own reading does.

hypotheses.hypothesis: NLMIXED keeps going longer before giving up
